llm_response.reason: Despite lack of active content, domain investigation and extensive news/consumer alert coverage confirm this site is strongly associated with the keto diet supplement scam pattern. Indicators include newly registered, privacy-protected domain, association with widely-reported scam tactics (miracle claims, unauthorized charges, fake endorsements, refund runarounds, sudden page removals), and lack of legitimate company presence. Multiple government and consumer protection organizations (FTC, AARP, BBB) have issued alerts about these scams, especially involving similar keto-branded offers.
